text_block_list.text:
One day, I come across Бива Хаяхидэ in
the
hallway, sighing at her reflection in a
window.
Sigh... Ugh, I can't even get the sides to settle down.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Same as ever, I'm afraid. Dealing with another bad hair day. And today's humidity has made things particularly bad. Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to always ask, but would you
mind
taking a look at the back, Tick—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
S-sorry! Please, don't worry about me. I
thought
you were Ticket, for a moment.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ wanders off, still sighing
all the
while.
